notes.title: 2024.12.17 updates
notes.content:
1. In order to reduce the complexity of kungfus and increase the diversity of construction, this update removes the internal power and related content
2. Reduced the difficulty of monsters in the level-breaking mode

notes.title: 2024-10-16 Update
notes.content:
New Quick Classic Mode:
1. Both the player and AI have only 1 health point
2. Refreshing does not consume gold coins
3. Greatly increase the initial gold coins, interest and gold coins obtained after victory
